newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Tiong Nam in private placement.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Tiong Nam in private placement.

text.p: Tiong Nam Transport Holdings Bhd said on Tuesday that it is proposing a private placement of 3.9 million new share representing about 10 percent of its issued and paid-up capital.

In a statement, the transportation firm said the issue price of the offer will be based on the lower of the weighted average market price for the past five days, or the closing market price prior to the announcement of the price fixing date, with a discount of not more than 10 percent.
It said the price fixing date would be announced following approval of the placement by the Securities Commission.
Proceeds from the placement will be used to repay short term debt from financial institutions, it said.
The proposed placement will increase its existing share capital from 39.1 million ringgit to 43.0 million ringgit.
